modules.name: Automatic drafts
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Automatically writes drafts in enabled messaging apps. You send them yourself. This and Automatic sending are alternative reply modes; enabling either one turns the other off.

modules.name: Automatic sending
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Adds automatic sending of replies in enabled messaging apps, including screen and notification replies. Replies are sent only after you choose Send and confirm the warning once (installing is not a confirmation); each person once gets a short note that an AI assistant helps you write, and you can keep review-first for single people. This and Automatic drafts are alternative reply modes; enabling either one turns the other off.

modules.name: Casual & short
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Short, relaxed replies like quick texts between friends: very short messages, emoji now and then, no full stop at the end of a one-line reply.

modules.name: Follow-ups
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Adds “If they don't reply” to Settings: when your message is the last one and the person doesn't answer, the app can write a short follow-up (at most 3; it waits longer if they haven't seen your message). It stays off until you turn it on there, and you can turn it off for a single person. Disable this module to hide it again; your choices are kept.

modules.name: Free AI (automatic)
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Writes replies with free AI providers and switches to the next one automatically when one runs out of free quota, is rate-limited or does not answer. OVHcloud and Pollinations work without a key; Gemini, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, GitHub Models, SambaNova, Cohere and LLM7 join once you add your own free key in AI models. Conversations are sent to these providers. Requires Messages AI 0.46.0 or newer.

modules.name: Friendly wording
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Simpler, friendlier English words on Home: Auto-reply, Ask me first, Send right away.

modules.name: Close Google ads
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Recognizes Google full-screen ads in other apps and presses an available Close or Skip control. Works independently of reply modules; does not press Install, advertiser links or reward-resume controls.

modules.name: Group chats
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Adds “Also reply in groups” (Settings → Timing, limits and behavior) and the “Skip group chats” switch for each app. Group chats stay skipped until you turn it on; everyone in a group reads the replies, so turn it on only for groups that expect it. Disable this module to hide it again.

modules.name: More messaging apps
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Adds Threema, Element and Session to Apps. They reply through the notification's Reply button.

modules.name: More reply languages
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Teaches the reply logic Finnish, Hungarian, Romanian and Swedish: the app then recognizes questions, requests, bad and good news, thanks and goodbyes in these languages and checks that a reply really answers them, like it does for the built-in languages. The words apply only to chats in that language. Also an example for authors who want to add their own language. Requires Messages AI 0.46.0 or newer.

modules.name: No AI footer
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Omits the automatic AI-assistance footer from replies sent through notifications or an open chat. Requires Messages AI 0.46.0 or newer. Disable this module to restore the default footer for conversations that have not received it. Does not enable sending or change saved disclosure history.

modules.name: No work talk
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Keeps private chats private: no talk about work, and a chat that turns urgent is handed to you.

modules.name: Ocean
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: A calm blue colour theme for light and dark mode.

modules.name: Reply suggestions
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Shows three movable Apple-style reply bubbles above an open chat without an enclosing panel. Their position is remembered and can be reset. Tap a bubble to use it, ↻ writes three new ones and × hides them until another chat opens.

modules.name: Skip ads during Auto
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Lets screen Auto close or skip ads in the apps where you turn on “Skip ads” (Apps → app) and mark an optional Close ad button. It waits for countdowns, never taps the advertiser and, on rewarded ads, continues the video to keep the reward. Without this module Auto waits until you close an ad yourself.

modules.name: SMS import
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: Adds “SMS import” to Learning: goes through all SMS chats on the phone (and the text of 1-to-1 MMS) and saves every person with their name from your contacts, together with your earlier messages. You choose whether to save everyone from your contacts or only chats you wrote in, and whether new SMS are imported automatically every few hours. Bank notices, codes, short numbers and group MMS are skipped. Nothing is read until you allow SMS access and confirm what is saved. GitHub version of the app only (the Google Play version doesn't read SMS). Disable this module to hide it again; saved people stay.

modules.name: Stranger chats
modules.author: Messages AI
modules.description: For anonymous chat apps such as RandoChat: adds “Start the conversation myself” (Settings → Timing, limits and behavior) and automatic new random chats for each app (Apps → app; mark the New chat button). Both stay off until you turn them on. Every new person still gets the one-time AI note when replies are sent automatically. Disable this module to hide them again.
